verdict.rationale: Automatic cost-aware configuration selection is a fair question for a crawling tool, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents Crawl4AI picking the cheapest configuration that still succeeds. The closest features are an automatic retry with a proxy chain and fallback fetch function, and adaptive crawling that decides when to stop. Neither is described as choosing the lowest-cost successful configuration, so both are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let the API automatically pick the cheapest configuration that still succeeds
